name: example-character
description: Generic 8-direction pixel character: RD rotation for stills, Wan 3 clip on chroma for the walk cycle, aligned and stitched into one atlas v2 sheet. Dry-runs everywhere unless run_pipeline.py --yes.

vars.character: astromech droid, blue and white dome, three legs

stages.name: anchor
stages.description: Identity anchor still with true alpha (GPT Image 2.5 Sunburst).

args.prompt: Full-body game sprite of ${character}, neutral pose, facing the viewer, centered, feet visible. Transparent background.

stages.name: rotate8
stages.description: Eight directions in one Retro Diffusion call, split and stitched with directions metadata.

stages.name: walk-clip
stages.description: Side-view walk cycle: first+last frame = the E direction still, generated on #00FF00, keyed once, feet-aligned, deduped.

args.prompt: side-view walk cycle in place, feet stay on one line, flat #00FF00 background, no camera motion

stages.name: walk-2x
stages.description: Deterministic 2x for HD displays without new colours.
